svg.title: Jungle Run layout
svg.text: JUNGLE RUN · Jungle Run · 66x44 tiles · road 3 tiles wide
Lap 196 tiles = 25,056 px · about 29 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 7.7 tiles · bridge crossing at 77°
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
